activity_summary: After the book was shut you lit a fresh candle and took up the twelfth leaf. You wrote one line, that he sings so they may think him glad. You did not write what happens next. The coffer stayed shut beside the leaves.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line, set the pen down, and did not continue.

facets.activity: Wrote one line on the twelfth leaf
